title: AWS GraphRAG deployment cuts drug research cycles by 87%
summary: AWS GraphRAG deployment achieved an 87% reduction in drug research cycles by integrating previously siloed proprietary databases into a unified queryable knowledge graph, enabling faster data gathering and screening phases that previously took over six months per iteration with only a 5% success rate.
problem_solved: Dramatically accelerates drug discovery timelines by eliminating data silos and enabling rapid cross-referencing of disparate pharmaceutical databases.
why_valuable: Reduces drug development time from months to days, potentially saving pharmaceutical companies millions while getting life-saving medications to patients faster.
